title: mandevilla × amabilis
intro: Mandevilla × amabilis, commonly known as the "Pink Mandevilla" or "Rocktrumpet", is a hybrid plant species within the Apocynaceae family, known for its vibrant pink flowers and ability to thrive in warm climates. The health benefits of Mandevilla × amabilis include its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily related to its anxiolytic and sedative effects, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents found in Mandevilla × amabilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential medicinal applications.
